order: Ruling 77 (orchestrator 18:09 ET Nov 13, with the builder's ruling 76; PBX 18:01: 'delete all the contents after like 6 to 12 hours so that we never reuse any of it'): media of a video published more than 12 h ago is deleted on a rolling basis by the watcher's own loop (no cron), EXCEPT the sources of DELIVERED videos; transcripts (text) and the provenance records (PROVENANCE.json, transcript hashes, the pins) are kept. Only the targets below are ever deleted from; everything under reported_not_purged is measured and reported, never deleted (the orchestrator's call).

targets.name: lock_precheck_sources
targets.what: the lock precheck's acquired sections: <work unit>/sources/<video id>.<ext>

targets.name: word_pass_temp
targets.what: the word-pass worker's downloaded audio and window WAVs, left behind only by a cycle that died (a finished cycle deletes its own)

delivered.note: a delivered video = one cut into a delivery: named by its edl.json / cuts_final.json / PIN.json, by PROVENANCE.json's sources, or by a file in its sources/ or transcripts/; a reference counts only with delivery evidence (reference_markers): references/editorial_failures and references/pinned (test pins) do not

reported_not_purged.name: run_render_media
reported_not_purged.what: renders' intermediates and QA cuts (qa/, VERIFY/): media cut from the sources

reported_not_purged.name: v3_clips_daily
reported_not_purged.what: video_pipeline_v3 clip_engine's daily raw downloads and branded clips (06:00 cron, --dry-run)

reported_not_purged.name: segment_pipelines
reported_not_purged.what: the earlier segment pipelines' work (v1-v3); segment_v2/sources holds the approved v2f reference's sources

reported_not_purged.name: old_v5_clips_and_audio
reported_not_purged.what: the March video_engine clips and audio
